{{Short description|German physicist and professor (1961–2018)}}
[[File:Bauer Siegfried.jpg|thumb|Siegfried Bauer in 2010]]

'''Siegfried Bauer''' (15 May 1961 – 30 December 2018)<ref>[https://www.wirtrauern.at/traueranzeige/siegfried-bauer-1961 Siegfried Bauer]</ref><ref>[https://www.nachrichten.at/oberoesterreich/nachrufe/Trauer-um-einen-visionaeren-Forscher;art86198,3089602 Trauer um einen visionären Forscher]</ref> was a German physicist and professor for [[Soft matter physics|soft-matter physics]] at [[Johannes Kepler University Linz]], Austria.
In 2016, he was elected [[Fellow of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers]] (IEEE)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://services27.ieee.org/fellowsdirectory/menuCHRONOLOGICAL.html?beginYr=2016&endYr=2016#results_table|title=2016 elevated fellow|website=IEEE Fellows Directory}}</ref> ''for contributions to the understanding and application of [[Electroactive polymers|electroactive polymer]] dielectrics''. In 2018, he was named Fellow of the [[SPIE|Society of Photo-Instrumentation Engineers]] (SPIE) "for achievements in [[Plastic electronics|plastic electronic]] devices and [[Soft matter physics|soft-matter physics]]".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://spie.org/membership/explore-membership/fellows/complete-list-of-spie-fellows?SSO=1|title=SPIE Fellows - Complete Listing|website=spie.org|access-date=2020-01-13}}</ref>
